name: audiodn
description: Hosted audio library for coding agents: store, play, and preview audio, plus AudioDN MCP and integration skills.

interface.shortDescription: A hosted place for agents to store, play, and preview audio — plus the APIs to put it in your app.
interface.longDescription: AudioDN (Audio Delivery Network) is hosted audio infrastructure. Add it to a Cursor bot or any app when you need a durable place to keep audio that agents come across — generated clips, downloads, voice notes, podcasts, UGC — then play, preview, and reuse those tracks. This plugin wires the hosted AudioDN MCP (docs without a key; live catalog/upload/playback tools after you paste an API Access key), teaches the correct security boundaries and API sequence (upload session → per-track create → processing readiness → play session or signed delivery), and is the AudioDN plugin for AI coding tools, not a separate product.
defaultPrompt: Store this audio in AudioDN so I can play and preview it later.
Add AudioDN to this app as the place agents store, play, and preview audio.
Add a secure AudioDN upload flow without exposing server API keys.
Audit our AudioDN integration for missing per-track uploads and client-side server keys.
